nodes.label: Foundational design decisions
nodes.rationale: Tenant-ready hoa_id on every table (multi-tenant is a migration not a rewrite); money split dues vs payments for later Stripe; temporal residency history; critical announcements bypass opt-outs; PII gate; bounded AI cost.

nodes.label: Permission-based access control (lib/permissions.ts role->permission map)
nodes.rationale: Routes check permission strings not roles, so adding a role only extends the map; routes do not change.

nodes.label: PII review gate (acknowledged_safe before ingestion)
nodes.rationale: No document is embedded for the chatbot until its PII review is cleared, keeping resident PII out of the AI index.

nodes.label: Stubbed integrations (graceful degradation)
nodes.rationale: Modules degrade gracefully without external creds so the app runs in dev without Anthropic/OpenAI/email/S3 keys.

nodes.label: Data retention & soft-delete policy
nodes.rationale: Audit 2y, notifications 90d hot, chat 1y then anonymize; soft-delete hoas/users/units, never hard delete.

nodes.label: Tenant isolation via session-derived hoa_id
nodes.rationale: hoa_id is never read from the request body; every domain query filters by it - multi-tenant by design even in Phase 1.

nodes.label: Registration Flow (/register -> pending -> admin approve)
nodes.rationale: Pending users fail login with the same message as wrong-password to avoid account-state enumeration.

nodes.label: Optional Resident Directory (Off / Admins only / All residents)
nodes.norm_label: optional resident directory (off / admins only / all residents)
nodes.rationale: Name and unit only, with per-resident opt-out, so boards can enable community listing without exposing PII.

nodes.label: Critical vs General Announcement Tagging
nodes.rationale: Critical (emergencies, legal notices, dues reminders) always emails and ignores opt-outs; General respects resident preferences, satisfying compliance opt-out rules without losing emergency reach.

nodes.label: Translation Review Workflow
nodes.rationale: A monolingual admin cannot verify a translation, so unreviewed translations show a 'Machine-translated, unverified' banner and Critical sends are held until a bilingual reviewer approves or an admin waives (audit-logged).

nodes.label: Bulk Resident Import (CSV)
nodes.rationale: Lets support team onboard a whole roster at once so activation does not depend on every resident self-registering.

nodes.label: Monthly HOA AI Budget Cap (80% alert, 100% gate)
nodes.norm_label: monthly hoa ai budget cap (80% alert, 100% gate)

nodes.label: PII Scan Gate on Ingestion (pii_review_status)
nodes.rationale: Regex + NER scan flags documents; nothing is chunked or embedded until an admin clears to acknowledged_safe, preventing PII leakage via chatbot.

nodes.label: RAG Pipeline (ingest -> chunk -> embed -> retrieve -> generate)
nodes.norm_label: rag pipeline (ingest -> chunk -> embed -> retrieve -> generate)
nodes.rationale: Chatbot does not know the documents; it retrieves relevant chunks and grounds the LLM answer in them with citations.

nodes.label: Next.js + TypeScript Stack
nodes.rationale: One language end to end, fast iteration, AI-friendly; chosen over Django, Rails, Laravel, Supabase-only.

nodes.label: Encrypted Object Storage with Signed URLs (S3/R2)
nodes.norm_label: encrypted object storage with signed urls (s3/r2)

nodes.label: Three-layer Enforcement (UI / Middleware / API)
nodes.rationale: If UI, middleware and API disagree, the API is the source of truth.

nodes.label: AI Cost Management
nodes.rationale: Unbounded chatbot use by one resident could exceed $500/month, so rate limits and budget caps are mandatory.

nodes.label: Foundational Decisions Baked In
nodes.rationale: Bake in tenant id, money split, temporal residency, notification prefs, PII gate and AI cost bounds from day one so later phases are small migrations, not rewrites.

nodes.label: hoa_id on Every Domain Table
nodes.rationale: Adding tenant id now is free; retrofitting tenant isolation across a live DB is not.

nodes.label: Dues CSV Import (idempotent)
nodes.rationale: Importing legacy spreadsheets preserves history; idempotent via row-level external_id and transactional so partial imports stay consistent.

nodes.label: Money Split: dues vs payments vs due_payments
nodes.norm_label: money split: dues vs payments vs due_payments
nodes.rationale: A payment may cover several dues and a due may be paid in parts; Stripe drops in without schema churn.

nodes.label: Soft-delete by Default
nodes.rationale: Hard deletes break audit trails and dues history.

nodes.label: Temporal Residency
nodes.rationale: unit_residents history keeps past dues attributed to the right owner as residents move.

nodes.label: verb:resource[:scope] Permission Convention
nodes.rationale: Routes ask for permissions, not roles, so new roles like secretary work automatically.

nodes.label: Six Modelled Roles (2 active, 4 Phase 2)
nodes.rationale: Pre-modelling roles makes activation a one-line Prisma enum migration with zero route changes.

nodes.label: graphify knowledge graph usage rules
nodes.rationale: Query the scoped graph (query/path/explain) before raw grep/reads to keep context small; run `graphify update .` after code changes; large graph.json diffs are expected.

nodes.label: LLM Model Provider Options (Claude / GPT-4 / open-source)
nodes.norm_label: llm model provider options (claude / gpt-4 / open-source)
nodes.rationale: Start with a commercial API to ship fast, evaluate cost, consider self-hosting if usage scales.
